task.title: Wire visitor chat opening and the message composer
task.input: M4 necessary-session/first-message/append/read APIs, M1 UI/client foundation, and existing InquiryWizard.
task.output: ContactChatEntry/ChatContainer/Composer/MessageList, active opening, first/subsequent submission, and explicit Refresh messages reads; automatic synchronization is owned separately by M4-T9.
task.accept: 1) Entry: home Request a quote -> /[locale]/contact -> Contact a person (contact-human-chat). Opening sends POST /api/chat/session. Send message (chat-send) calls POST /api/chat/conversations or its messages endpoint. Data source also includes GET /api/chat/conversations/[id]. Actual clicks assert id/seq/receivedAt; do not display received before success (E-31). 2) When the service is reachable but unstaffed, show Offline message without an online indicator. After persistence show Received, awaiting human handling with no instant-reply promise. Blank/omitted email can send; invalid/overlong email errors retain the message. Closing an unsent draft does not persist it (E-17, E-36, E-38, E-39). 3) Cookie 401/404 or a closed thread stops old submissions and shows an explicit Start a new conversation button. Do not automatically send the old draft into a new conversation. Declining analytics still permits consultation and loads no third-party scripts (E-40, E-85). Use the unique minimalist-flat style from section 11. At the actual service at 1920x1080, 1440x900, and 390x844, record GIFs and computed styles: 2px black borders, zero radius, no shadow, and accent #b45700. On each admin page, run D1-D6 and overflow probes with work/form/card and density7/gutter16/gap16/pad16. Labels and keyboard focus are reachable; touch-control targets measure at least 44px.
